<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`  _(via maxVisible (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps), mobileMaxVisible (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via maxVisible (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps), mobileMaxVisible (symbol, a field of const object PageHeaderProps, an authorable key of ui/PageHeaderProps))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via PageHeaderProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fe753492ff75316c6325fb3f9db920386e61d3a0` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `162eb2ddc7021d4b76264740ad0b7e680c88822b` — the merge of head `b69bbad5336575ca10b6a088ea42734d4fef681b` into base `fe753492ff75316c6325fb3f9db920386e61d3a0`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 162eb2ddc7021d4b76264740ad0b7e680c88822b && git checkout 162eb2ddc7021d4b76264740ad0b7e680c88822b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin fe753492ff75316c6325fb3f9db920386e61d3a0 b69bbad5336575ca10b6a088ea42734d4fef681b && git checkout -B drift-repro fe753492ff75316c6325fb3f9db920386e61d3a0 && git merge --no-ff b69bbad5336575ca10b6a088ea42734d4fef681b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json fe753492ff75316c6325fb3f9db920386e61d3a0
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs fe753492ff75316c6325fb3f9db920386e61d3a0` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读
- 记录页和侧边抽屉的顶部改成两行。上面一行是导航：上一条、下一条，「第 N 条，共 M 条 · 视图名」（点视图名回到列表），最右边是关闭。下面一行是记录本身：图标、名称（字号大一号）、状态标签和操作按钮。

- 页面上协作者头像和托管包标记移进记录行，不再压在标签页上方。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · head `1066603fa3` · card #35853 (claim 7042033558; covers #35840; PR-1 #35910 merged as `d6be99d50c`) · K=3 · merge-tree vs `origin/main` clean · governed: none · size +937/−240 = 1,177, 24 files (under 3000) · CI 61 success, 9 skipped · 2026-11-21T05:05Z

**reviewFace** (changeset as `declaredOn`): face `schema`, tier `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, `hits.schema` = `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `hits.rules` empty. Routing: **seat L2 at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER**, then the area lands it (not Tier H). The spec delta touches only the `maxVisible` / `mobileMaxVisible` describe text and docblock. No shape changes and no value domain changes. The unset default in the record bar moves from 1 to 3 plus a width fold. That is a change in what renders, not in what parses. The body says `Clause-②: no`, and the seat rules on narrowing.

- Width fold (`fitWidth`):
  - A layout effect with no deps reads whether the toolbar's last child wraps below the first. It lowers `widthCap` one action at a time, but never below the primary (`floor`).
  - A ResizeObserver on `[data-record-top-bar]` resets the cap when the bar's width changes. The bar's width is set by its container, not its content, so folding cannot feed the observer.
  - Wrapping does happen. The title cell is `min-w-32 flex-1` and the controls are `min-w-0 shrink`, so the `flex-wrap max-w-full` row wraps once the title reaches 128 px.
  - Host buttons (Edit) take no slot. Bar face and mobile are excluded.
  - `defaultMaxVisible={inBar ? 1 : undefined}` is replaced by `fitWidth={inBar}`, and the designer describes follow.
- Two rows:
  - `RecordTopBar` takes `record`. The nav row carries `leading`, ↑ ↓ and 「第 N 条，共 M 条 · scope」, with `onScope` as a link. The frame sits at the far right. The record row carries the title slot, the actions and the toggles. Without `record` it is the one-row bar (the phone).
  - The page's ✕ is `pageReturn.toList`, falling back to the object's list. The drawer's scope link closes the drawer.
  - `stepperHidden` is no longer passed, and that reversal of #35593 is disclosed.
  - Badges move into the page's record row and still float in panes.
- Overlap: #35977 conflicts only in the generated `sdui-manifest.record.json`, and whoever lands second regenerates it. The drift choices are in the body.

R1, a text-only claim amendment: the diff touches files outside claim 7042033558. These are `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx` with its two `__tests__` files, `ApprovalsInboxPage.queueStepper-34586.test.tsx`, and the generated `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`. The #35854 claim names `recordDrawerStack.tsx`, but that card is closed and this PR fixes #35853.

- Nit: with no list, the drawer's root crumb is now plain text, where it used to be a button that closed the drawer. The changeset says "the object's name, linking to the object's list" for both faces. Either restore the link in the drawer or narrow that sentence to the page.
- Nit: `widthCap` is reset only by a width change. If the action set shrinks while the width stays the same (for example, stepping ↑ ↓ to a record with fewer or shorter actions while the header stays mounted), the low cap stays and fewer buttons show than would fit. This is a candidate follow-up card, not a blocker.

## Contract review

Head-sha: `1066603fa34cc7d0e2ab6ec73d836287fb67e368`

The rest of the diff (tests, e2e, the checklist item, the app-shell hosts, the changeset prose, hand-written docs, generated output) is the lane seat's ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@objectstack/spec` accept set: unchanged — right.** `PageHeaderProps.maxVisible` and `mobileMaxVisible` are `z.number().int().positive().optional()` on both sides of the diff. The hunk is two `.describe()` strings and one docblock sentence. No key, no accepted value, no requirement and no schema default moves; `component.zod.ts` is the only `packages/spec` path in the diff, so no `authorable-surface`, `authorable-defaults` or `api-surface` shard moves either.
- **Not a narrowing — right as declared on that point.** The 2026-11-19 ruling, as `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` encodes it (the fifth leg, `Narrowed Spec Change`), is about a change that 「收紧作者能写的东西（会让现有应用报错）」: a key removed or tombstoned, a value refused, a requirement tightened. Nothing an author wrote before this PR is refused after it, and no published member is retired: `stepperHidden` and `defaultMaxVisible` stay on their prop types (the console simply stops passing them). The unset budget in the record bar moves up, from 1 to 3. #35910 carried the arm because it retired `NavigationOverlayProps.maximizable` and `ListViewProps.recordOpen`; this diff retires nothing.
- **Describe against renderer, desktop — agrees.** `containers.tsx` resolves the row budget as `readMax(rawMaxVisible) ?? defaultMaxVisible ?? 3`, and at this head no caller passes `defaultMaxVisible` (the one that did, `defaultMaxVisible={inBar ? 1 : undefined}`, is replaced by `fitWidth={inBar}`), so unset is 3 on every header. In the host's bar the layout effect lowers `widthCap` one action at a time while the toolbar's last child sits below its first, never below one authored action, and the host's Edit takes no slot: "actions that do not fit its width fold as well, so a narrow drawer shows fewer" is what runs.
- **Describe against renderer, phone — agrees.** The bottom bar (`face: 'bar'`) reads `readMax(rawMobileMaxVisible) ?? PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS` (2), and its queue puts the host's buttons first, so an editable record draws Edit, the primary and the `⋯`: "2 … where the host's Edit counts as one". Any other header on a mobile viewport reads `?? 1`. The width fold is off on both (`fitWidth && !barFace && !isMobile`), so the phone is unchanged, as the card asks.
- **Generated references — match.** The two rows of `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` equal the two describe strings character for character; `sdui.manifest.json` and `content/docs/ui/components/page.mdx` carry the two designer descriptions of `containers.tsx` verbatim, and the manifest's sha256 equals the one in `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`. `TypeScript Type Check` (which carries `check:docs`) and `Lint & Repo Gates` are success on the head.
- **`@object-ui/components` public entry: widened, and the PR declares no widening — wrong (S2).** Four new optional members are reachable from the package entry: `RecordTopBarProps.record`, `RecordTopBarStepper.onScope` (both through `export * from './record-top-bar'`), `NavigationOverlayProps.recordRow` and `PageHeaderActionsProps.fitWidth`.

### ② Semver level

- **`patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, under `Metadata-protocol: none` — holds.** Nothing changes in what a metadata author can write. The number is the renderer's own fallback: the docblock above the two keys states "Optional with NO schema default, deliberately", and the same-key changes on `main` (#35593 moving the bar to 1, #35660 and #35840 restating it) all shipped as `none`. Measured against the last release, 18.6.0, the unset desktop budget is 3 before and after: the 1 landed on 2026-11-20, after the 2026-11-18 version commit, and its changeset is still pending, so no published version ever carried it. Had the 1 shipped, moving it back would be `semantic` and `minor`; it did not. `Check Changeset` is success.
- **`Clause-②: no` — the `(narrowing)` arm, the `!` and a BREAKING banner are not owed** (① above), and no ADR-0087 disposition is owed with them.
- **`Clause-②: no` is wrong in the other direction: S2.** The value answers whether the diff widens a published accept set or public surface, and the four members above widen `@object-ui/components`' entry. The repo's own spelling for exactly this shape is `.changeset/35685-list-state-confirm.md` ("`Clause-②: yes (widening)` — `GridCellSelection` in `@object-ui/components` takes an optional `confirmCommit` member; nothing removed or renamed"), and #35910 treated a member of the same `NavigationOverlayProps` as published surface when it retired one. Under ruling A the level stays `patch`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag, "the seat L2 rules on whether the default change counts as narrowing":** answered — it does not (①). The declaration is still corrected, to the widening arm (S2).
- **Overlap with #35977 (draft), which also touches `component.zod.ts`:** a merge that changes only `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` and `sdui.manifest.json` by regeneration stays under this record with a `Regen-provenance:` line; a merge that moves `component.zod.ts` or `containers.tsx` is a new head and owes a delta.

- **SQL push-down:** nothing to check. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join; it is layout, a describe and their tests.
- **Governed surface, author, size:** no governed path in the file list (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success), authored by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` on an internal branch, 1,177 changed lines. Security-touching: no.
- **No ADR governs the budget:** `docs/adr/**` and `scripts/adr-anchors/**` name neither `maxVisible` nor the record bar. The 1 was a coordinator choice in #35593, and the card records the maintainer's question about it.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (hits).** The change holds against the renderer it describes and against the card's item 5 and its acceptance line (1280 px: three and the `⋯`; a drawer: fewer by width; 390 px: one). Both strings are true of the tree at this head, on desktop and on a phone, and the docblock's new parenthesis ("3 on desktop, folded by width in a record page's header bar … the mobile one differs by host") is true as well. Tried against it: an unset key in the bar (3, then folded), an authored key in the bar (the authored number, then folded), an out-of-contract value (falls to the default through `readMax`), a mobile viewport without the phone face (1, no fold), a read-only record on a phone (two authored buttons, no Edit to count). None contradicts the text.

N1 (nit) — the width-fold clause sits inside the sentence that opens "Renderer default when unset:", but the renderer applies it to an authored value too (`Math.min(maxVisible, widthCap)`): an authored `maxVisible: 4` in a narrow drawer shows fewer than four. The designer description says the same thing as a sentence of its own, which reads unambiguously. No test pins an authored number above the default in the bar, or an authored number under the fold (the #35593 pin moved from authored 3 over default 1 to authored 1 under default 3). Left as an accepted deviation unless the head moves anyway for S1, in which case making the clause its own sentence ("In a record page's header bar the number is an upper bound: …") and regenerating the reference row would settle it.

**`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (implements).** The budget resolution, the fold and the two designer descriptions agree with the describe, sentence by sentence, with one exception.

S1 (should-fix) — `containers.tsx:1947`, the JSDoc of the exported `PageHeaderActionsProps.maxVisible`, still reads "an out-of-contract value falls back to the unset default: 1 in a record page's one-row header (`defaultMaxVisible`), 3 on any other header". At this head nothing passes `defaultMaxVisible`, so the fallback is 3 on every header; the sentence contradicts the describe this PR lands, ships in the package's typings, and is the same class of text #35840 was filed and fixed for. The claim's file surface names "comments that follow the new default" and the body says the stale budget comments are covered. Fix: state 3 on every header, folded by width in the host's bar (`fitWidth`).

N2 (nit) — `widthCap` is cleared only when the bar's width changes. When the set of visible actions changes at the same width (a record whose state swaps a long label for short ones), actions that would now fit stay folded until the next resize. Nothing is lost (the primary stays, the rest are in the `⋯`), and the describe promises only that what does not fit folds. A follow-up, not this head's.

**`ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx` (implements).** `data-record-top-bar` is on both the one-row and the two-row root, so the fold's `closest('[data-record-top-bar]')` finds its host on every face; the bar is a stretched column item, so its width follows its container and folding cannot feed the observer. The record row gives the title `min-w-32 flex-1` and the controls `min-w-0 shrink`, which is what lets the toolbar wrap and therefore fold. Without `record` the bar is the one-row bar it was, which is the phone's. Agrees.

**`ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx` (implements).** Passes `recordRow` through as `record` and keeps `stepperHidden` accepted. Agrees.

S2 (should-fix) — the `Clause-②:` line, in the PR body and in `.changeset/35853-record-header-two-rows.md`, reads `no`; the diff widens `@object-ui/components`' published entry by four optional members, so it reads `Clause-②: yes (widening)` followed by the members and "nothing removed or renamed", as the changeset for #35593 listed its own additions. Both carriers are prose faces: the level, the `Metadata-protocol: none` line and every gate verdict are unchanged by the correction.

Open on this head: S1, S2. Nits N1 and N2 do not hold the round.

- **What moved, in scope: two sentences, no code — right.** `component.zod.ts` changes one `.describe()` string (`maxVisible`); the schema expression beside it is untouched, as are the `mobileMaxVisible` string and the docblock. `containers.tsx` changes one JSDoc line (`:1947`); the budget resolution (`readMax(rawMaxVisible) ?? defaultMaxVisible ?? 3`), the fold (`Math.min(maxVisible, widthCap)`, `fitWidth && !barFace && !isMobile`), `fitWidth={inBar}` and both designer descriptions are byte-identical to the reviewed head. `record-top-bar.tsx` and `navigation-overlay.tsx` did not move.
